_archetype.name: IGT Triple Diamond chassis + Lightning Link tier naming fusion
_archetype.source: 1) Triple Diamond chassis (https://igamingnj.com/slots/triple-diamond-igt/) — 3-reel 1-line classic, wild × N substitution mechanic, 95.06% RTP. 2) Lightning Link mini/minor/major/grand jackpot tier UX (https://www.knowyourslots.com/five-things-to-know-about-lightning-link-dragon-link-and-dollar-storm/). 3) Published M37 baseline: machineconfig/M37Cfg.txt _excel.M37Reel skin 1/2/5/7 (26 stops, 13 Blank + 13 non-Blank alternating; R2 booster + R1/R3 plain wild).
_archetype.confidence: medium-high — Triple Diamond chassis is industry-published; M37Cfg published machine itself is the per-reel baseline authority for the booster/wild placement convention.
_archetype.modifications_from_archetype: Self-original symbol order (not byte-copy of M37Cfg). Per-reel symbol counts mirror M37Cfg skin 1 marginal targets (blank ~22-30%/70%, booster R2 only, plain wild R1+R3 only). Symbol arrangement designed to satisfy §13 BLANK-FLANK-DIVERSITY (no X-Blank-X) + same-symbol cyclic spacing ≥ 8 stops in 26-stop strip. Strip md5 will diverge from M37Cfg — by design, since slot_designer iterates weights independently of published machine.

_invariants: 26 physical stops per reel; shared symbol layout (position -> symbol) byte-identical across all modes — only per-mode weights vary.

Blank / non-Blank STRICT alternation on all 3 reels (B-N-B-N-... pattern from pos 0 to pos 25). 13 Blank + 13 non-Blank per reel. NO 3-consecutive-blank or 3-consecutive-non-blank chains anywhere. Universal rule per project_slot_designer.md (§E strip layout) (Harrigan near-miss band).
R1 and R3 INDEPENDENT non-blank symbol sequences (Triple Diamond convention — left/right reel have different dramatic roles).
BOOSTER (mini/minor/major/grand) appear ONLY on R2; plain WILD appears ONLY on R1 + R3 (M37 paytable rule, see specs/M37.spec.json).

_symbol_role.high7: regular pay_id 1 (10× line_3_same) — top-tier anchor, only path to 1000× via × grand booster
_symbol_role.wild: plain wild ×1 — substitutes any non-blank, R1+R3 only
_symbol_role.mini: booster ×2 (Mini Jackpot UX tier), R2 only
_symbol_role.minor: booster ×5 (Minor Jackpot UX tier), R2 only
_symbol_role.major: booster ×10 (Major Jackpot UX tier), R2 only
_symbol_role.grand: booster ×100 (Grand Jackpot anchor — feeds 1000× top via high7 path), R2 only

_per_reel_symbol_counts._note: 26 stops per reel = 13 Blank + 13 non-Blank. Per-symbol counts reflect M37Cfg skin 1 marginal targets after layout assignment.
_per_reel_symbol_counts.R2: blank×13, 1bar×1, 2bar×2, 3bar×2, 7bar×2, high7×2, mini×1, minor×1, major×1, grand×1 = 26
